title: Weekend road round-up: Chebet breaks South American all-comers' record in Buenos Aires — World Athletics
claims: World Athletics' 2019 race report says Evans Chebet won the Buenos Aires Marathon in 2:05:02, breaking the South American all-comers' record at the IAAF Bronze Label race.
The same report says the previous course record was 2:05:21 and that Chebet's time took 28 seconds off his personal best.
World Athletics' 2019 season top list and the event's course-record table give Chebet's mark as 2:05:00, two seconds faster than the race report; both values are preserved here.
Rodah Tanui won the 2019 women's race in 2:25:46, taking almost five minutes off the women's course record.
Evans Chebet's 2:05:00 remains the men's course record; Rebecca Chesir's 2:23:36 in 2026 is the women's course record.
